status.description: done when task and checks succeeded; blocked on unrecoverable error; needs_input when user decision is required.

changed_files.description: Relative paths of files created, modified, or deleted.

summary.description: Up to 5 terse factual bullets describing what changed. No disclaimers, hedging, or pasted code.

passed.description: Whether the command exited with code 0.

note.description: Terse 1-line outcome (e.g. '24 passed' or concise failure cause).

checks.description: Checks executed by Codex before finishing.

blockers.description: Concrete unresolved failures or required user decisions. Empty array if none.
